content.title: Where to watch McNeese take on Vanderbilt in first round of NCAA Tournament
content.text: Skip to contentLAKE CHARLES, La. (KPLC) - The No. 12 McNeese Cowboys will face the No. 5 Vanderbilt Commodores in the first round of the NCAA Tournament today at 2:15.The game will be televised on TruTV, and many Lake Area businesses are holding watch parties for fans to cheer on the Pokes.RELATED COVERAGE:Cowboys on the national stage before the NCAA tournamentMcNeese Courtside Cowboys bring heckles, chants and band pride to national stageFrom student manager to viral sensation, Amir Khan returns to NCAA Tournament spotlightMcNeese Cowboys land in OKC for NCAA TournamentGuzzardo and Armstrong agree to new deals with McNeeseGarcia leads Cowboys to third-straight Southland Conference Tournament ChampionshipThe Cowgirls will also take on Texas A&M at 7 p.m. in the first round of the Women’s Basketball Invitation Tournament.
